title: Pseudo-coherence over a coherent ring via coherence of cohomology
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises m-pseudo-coherence of a bounded above complex over a coherent ring by finiteness of the top cohomology in the bounding degree together with coherence, equivalently finite presentation, of the higher cohomology modules. The proof observes that over a coherent ring coherence and finite presentation agree, so two of the conditions coincide, and then shows that a module which is the quotient of a finite free module with coherent kernel has a resolution by finite free modules: the kernel is again coherent, so the procedure repeats, which is exactly the statement that the module is pseudo-coherent. The main equivalence is then assembled from the cohomology-by-cohomology criterion and the module-level statement, and the final sentence specialises to all degrees.
